candidates.name: Sofy24 Mini · compact L
candidates.qualification: Published 200 × 130 cm option; 190 × 140 cm bed; DL pull-forward seat / fold-down back; storage. Open outer depth 150 cm includes a provisional 10 cm frame allowance. Chaise width 72 cm and internal mechanism geometry require supplier confirmation.

candidates.name: IKEA TORNSBORG · smaller straight sleeper
candidates.qualification: Published 154 × 95 cm closed and 195 cm total unfolded depth; 140 × 195 cm bed. Straight sofa, not an L. Detailed moving linkage is schematic.

candidates.name: IKEA LYCKSELE · smaller straight sleeper
candidates.qualification: Published 142 × 100 cm closed; 140 × 188 cm bed. Open outer depth 198 cm includes a provisional 10 cm frame allowance. Straight sofa, not an L.
